Hello Yunus,
We’re pleased to inform you that the charger is now healthy and operating normally. There are currently no active errors.
The charger had entered failsafe mode due to a
'DC1_StateMonitor_KF13'
error, which occurred while the SECC was attempting to establish a connection. This issue has since cleared, and the system has recovered without further intervention.
If everything is now working as expected on your end, please confirm so we can proceed to close the case.
If you have any further concerns or questions, feel free to contact.
